goal: At least 10x lower complete CPU execution-proof production time, from execution/capture through the recursive execution root

baseline.scope: Existing complete D2 qualifications: sum of separate native and recursive producer commands, not a controlled median.

acceptance: Same complete fixture and expected public output. Smaller blocks and prefixes do not qualify.
Count execution, capture, witness construction, setup, native proving and all wrapping/folding through the root. Report fresh reception and corruption controls separately.
A new guest ELF needs regenerated ABI symbols and native/independent execution agreement.
CPU only, same hardware and bounded resources. Use repeated quiet runs after correctness gates.
Keep the 128-bit security target under documented assumptions. New cryptographic suites require explicit review and physical qualification; no whole-protocol certificate is claimed.
Close authenticated RAM and every service relation. No omitted truth providers or unchecked host answers.
